note: One decision per item of scripts/acp-features.mjs (the SDK's runtime exports). implemented/used/consumed/handled rows name what does it and, where one exists, the test; not-advertised/not-used/not-consumed/ignored rows say why.

agent-capability:auth.status.reason: unstable; sign-in state is read from the CLI (account.js)

agent-capability:loadSession.how: session/load for native cold continuity, history quarantined

agent-capability:mcpCapabilities.reason: the bridge is a stdio MCP server, which every ACP agent must take

agent-capability:mcpCapabilities.acp.reason: unstable MCP over ACP; the bridge is stdio

agent-capability:promptCapabilities.audi.reason: DSH sends no audio to ACP agents

agent-capability:promptCapabilities.embe.reason: uploads go as text or images (upload-content.js); embedded resources are not sent

agent-capability:promptCapabilities.imag.how: image blocks only to an agent that takes them

agent-capability:providers.reason: unstable; provider choice is DSH's route

agent-capability:sessionCapabilities.how: read for resume, systemPrompt, close and fork

agent-capability:sessionCapabilities.add.reason: one workspace per DSH chat; extra roots would widen what the agent reaches beyond the chat's sandbox

agent-capability:sessionCapabilities.arc.reason: unstable; DSH archive is its own

agent-capability:sessionCapabilities.clo.how: session/close after a fork or renew; called whatever is advertised and a refusal is left as it is (acp.js closeReplacedSession)

agent-capability:sessionCapabilities.del.reason: a DSH chat's deletion does not delete the CLI's own session store; that stays the CLI's

agent-capability:sessionCapabilities.lis.reason: DSH's chat list is the history; agent-side session lists are not shown

agent-capability:sessionCapabilities.opt.reason: unstable; configOptions on session answers are used instead

agent-capability:sessionCapabilities.res.how: session/resume first for native cold continuity on a qualified route

agent-capability:sessionCapabilities.sta.reason: unstable; turn state comes from the prompt request

agent-capability:sessionCapabilities.sys.how: Bot identity as systemPrompt append, else a preamble

client-capability:auth.reason: sign-in runs the agent's own auth methods (login.js); terminal auth would take over a terminal DSH does not own

client-capability:elicitation.reason: DSH user questions are asked through the bridge's ask tool with its consent; an ACP elicitation has no DSH dialog mapping yet

client-capability:fs.reason: DSH's tools reach the agent through the dsh MCP bridge with DSH's approval; a client fs/terminal would run outside DSH's tool consent and sandbox

client-capability:plan.how: plan_update and plan_removed become plugin:acp-dsh/plan records and the todo panel

client-capability:session.reason: no session-related client extension below is advertised

client-capability:session.compaction.reason: DSH owns compaction of its own transcript; an agent's compaction updates have no DSH row yet

client-capability:session.configOptions.reason: config options are read from session answers and config_option_update without the extension

client-capability:session.cursors.reason: unstable; no DSH surface shows an agent cursor

client-capability:session.notices.reason: no DSH notice row is defined for agent notices; advertising would invite updates nothing shows

client-capability:session.promptSuggesti.reason: unstable; suggestions validate and are ignored (test/sdk-2-7-surface.test.js)

client-capability:subagents.reason: subagent work is shown from tool calls (workersOf in acp.js); exposed subagent sessions would need their own routes and approvals

client-capability:terminal.reason: DSH's tools reach the agent through the dsh MCP bridge with DSH's approval; a client fs/terminal would run outside DSH's tool consent and sandbox

method:agent:auth/status.reason: unstable; sign-in state is read from the CLI

method:agent:mcp/message.reason: unstable MCP over ACP; the bridge is stdio

method:agent:providers/disable.reason: unstable; DSH routes choose the provider

method:agent:providers/list.reason: unstable; DSH routes choose the provider

method:agent:providers/set.reason: unstable; DSH routes choose the provider

method:agent:session/archive.reason: unstable; DSH archives its own chats

method:agent:session/delete.reason: the CLI keeps its own session store

method:agent:session/status.reason: unstable; the prompt request is the turn state

method:agent:session/unarchive.reason: unstable; DSH archives its own chats

method:client:fs/read_text_file.reason: DSH's tools reach the agent through the dsh MCP bridge with DSH's approval; a client fs/terminal would run outside DSH's tool consent and sandbox; unanswered with Method Not Found

method:client:fs/write_text_file.reason: DSH's tools reach the agent through the dsh MCP bridge with DSH's approval; a client fs/terminal would run outside DSH's tool consent and sandbox; unanswered with Method Not Found

method:client:mcp/message.reason: unstable MCP over ACP; the bridge is stdio

method:client:session/request_permission.how: DSH approval dialog through the mirror tool

method:client:terminal/create.reason: DSH's tools reach the agent through the dsh MCP bridge with DSH's approval; a client fs/terminal would run outside DSH's tool consent and sandbox; unanswered with Method Not Found

method:client:terminal/kill.reason: DSH's tools reach the agent through the dsh MCP bridge with DSH's approval; a client fs/terminal would run outside DSH's tool consent and sandbox; unanswered with Method Not Found

method:client:terminal/output.reason: DSH's tools reach the agent through the dsh MCP bridge with DSH's approval; a client fs/terminal would run outside DSH's tool consent and sandbox; unanswered with Method Not Found

method:client:terminal/release.reason: DSH's tools reach the agent through the dsh MCP bridge with DSH's approval; a client fs/terminal would run outside DSH's tool consent and sandbox; unanswered with Method Not Found

method:client:terminal/wait_for_exit.reason: DSH's tools reach the agent through the dsh MCP bridge with DSH's approval; a client fs/terminal would run outside DSH's tool consent and sandbox; unanswered with Method Not Found

method:protocol:$/cancel_request.how: a withdrawn permission request closes its DSH question (onPermission signal)

prompt-response:usage.how: unstable; recorded once per prompt with completeness and per-route semantics, never a DSH usage chunk (meter owns cost, RFC 0018)

update:available_commands_update.reason: agent slash commands are not offered in DSH's composer

update:compaction_update.reason: no compaction capability advertised; DSH owns its transcript

update:notice.reason: no client notices capability; no DSH row for it

update:plan.how: legacy whole plan, kept under id "plan"

update:plan_removed.how: removes a known plan; an unknown id is ignored as ACP requires

update:plan_update.how: plan records and the todo panel; markdown kept as text, its path never opened

update:prompt_suggestions_update.reason: unstable; validated and ignored, later text arrives (test/sdk-2-7-surface.test.js)

update:session_message.reason: sent to subagent-aware clients only; not advertised

update:session_message_chunk.reason: sent to subagent-aware clients only; not advertised

update:tool_call.how: a DSH tool card (mirror) or the bridge's own card

update:usage_update.how: context occupancy, latest wins, recorded with the prompt's usage

update:user_message_chunk.reason: DSH writes the person's own rows; an agent echo would duplicate them (and is quarantined during load)
